description: Bulk sibling of FreshnessPolicyComponent -- one config block declares freshness policies for many assets at once, grouped by cadence tier and selected by tag/group/kind/selection-DSL (not a hand-listed asset_keys array), instead of one component instance per asset.

outputs.description: One freshness AssetCheckResult per selected asset across every declared group.

groups.label: Groups
groups.description: List of {name, policy_type, selection, ...policy fields}. Same policy_type/field shape as FreshnessPolicyComponent (time_window: fail_window_hours; cron: deadline_cron + lower_bound_delta_hours + optional timezone). `selection` is an explicit asset-key list, the full Dagster selection DSL (tag:/group:/kind:/boolean composition), '*' for everything, or a bare fnmatch glob.

name: Bulk Freshness Policies
